sources.name: FPGA-Agent-skills2
sources.rationale: GPL-family and centered on proprietary Vivado workflows rather than a vendor-neutral reusable RTL corpus.

sources.name: GateTruth
sources.rationale: RTL-generation benchmark tasks are isolated to prevent evaluation-answer contamination.

sources.name: MAGE
sources.rationale: Evaluation-oriented generated RTL is not admitted to an engineering retrieval namespace.

sources.name: Pro-V-main
sources.rationale: The source is not a pinned Git checkout and has no reviewed redistribution license.

sources.name: REvolution
sources.rationale: The multi-gigabyte generated benchmark corpus is intentionally excluded as low-signal bulk data.

sources.name: RTL-Agent
sources.rationale: High benchmark-contamination risk and unknown license block ingestion.

sources.name: RTLFixer
sources.rationale: The pinned repository contains no tracked Verilog or SystemVerilog records to ingest.

sources.name: booley
sources.rationale: Nearly all HDL files are evaluation fixtures; admit distilled patterns only after independent review.

sources.name: duck-rtl
sources.rationale: Examples intentionally include failing and deadlocking designs without linked negative evidence.

sources.name: ibex
sources.rationale: Production SystemVerilog CPU RTL with a pinned Apache-2.0 source identity; only the first-party rtl directory is selected.

sources.name: llm4cov_oss
sources.rationale: LLM coverage experiments and their fixtures are not reusable RTL library material.

sources.name: picorv32
sources.rationale: Pinned ISC-licensed RISC-V RTL with a compact core and open SoC examples.

sources.name: pulp_axi
sources.rationale: Pinned Apache-2.0 AXI/AXI-Lite implementation and its directly associated testbench sources.

sources.name: rtl-skills
sources.rationale: A small pinned Apache-2.0 set of RTL testbench templates, isolated as raw verification patterns.

sources.name: rtl2gds-agent
sources.rationale: Physical-design agent fixtures and benchmark content are outside the curated RTL retrieval scope.

sources.name: sv-tests
sources.rationale: Pinned ISC-licensed public SystemVerilog conformance cases, isolated as language fixtures rather than design templates.

sources.name: turtle
sources.rationale: High benchmark-contamination risk prevents use in Codex engineering retrieval.

sources.name: uvm-core
sources.rationale: Official pinned Apache-2.0 UVM implementation, isolated as raw verification patterns rather than synthesizable RTL.

sources.name: verilog-axis
sources.rationale: Pinned MIT-licensed AXI Stream RTL with its directly associated open testbench wrappers.

sources.name: verilog-eval
sources.rationale: Public RTL benchmark answers are excluded from retrieval to preserve evaluation integrity.

sources.name: wb2axip
sources.rationale: Useful RTL remains quarantined until its repository-level license can be identified and reviewed.
